Qualifying Generalizations in German: B1 Phrase Practice

Avoid turning some or most cases into all cases in German. Practise meistens, manche and Ausnahmen with translations and explained B1 phrase exercises.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

Meistens describes what happens in most cases, while manche refers to some members of a group. Nicht alle limits a claim about the whole group. Es gibt Ausnahmen explicitly allows exceptions. These expressions concern a claim's scope or frequency, which is different from how certain the speaker feels about it.

Common mistake to avoid

Manche does not mean all. Meistens is a general frequency expression, not an exact numerical percentage supplied by the word alone.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1In unserer Gruppe beginnt die Besprechung meistens pünktlich.In our group the meeting usually starts on time.
Worked example 2Es gibt aber Ausnahmen, etwa bei einem Raumwechsel.But there are exceptions, for example when the room changes.
Worked example 3Nicht alle Teilnehmenden nutzen dieselbe Lernmethode.Not all participants use the same learning method.
Worked example 4Manche Aufgaben lassen sich gut zu zweit lösen.Some tasks can be solved well in pairs.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the limited generalization using the frequency word, group word or exception noun specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: alle · Ausnahmen · Manche · meistens

Question 1. Der Kurs findet ___ im selben Raum statt. (usually)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: meistens

Meistens describes the usual case without making it universal.

Question 2. Von dieser Regel gibt es ___. (exceptions)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Ausnahmen

Ausnahmen explicitly identifies cases outside the general pattern.

Question 3. Nicht ___ arbeiten gleich schnell. (all)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: alle

Nicht alle limits the statement about the whole group.

Question 4. ___ bevorzugen eine schriftliche Anleitung. (some people)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Manche

Manche names some members of the group and is capitalised here.
